notes.title: Fixed file read error (updated to ver2.15)
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

I was able to reproduce the problem with the saved data received from the user, so I was able to correct more accurately.

I would like to take this moment to say thank you.
Thank you for responding again and again.

If this version seems stable, I would like to add deleted content.

notes.title: Fixed File Read Error(Updated to ver2.12)
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

I uploaded the client that fixed the image file reading error.

I think that it was probably fixed.

If problems arise, we apologize, please contact us again.

notes.title: Fixed the image files loading error(updated to ver2.11)
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

Fixed a bug that the image files could not be read.

This update is a mechanism to rewrite the contents of the savedata at the time of loading, so it will be automatically corrected if you load the previous save.
(You can now play with save data files before 2.10 too.)

If stable startup is possible, in the next update, add Takeda and Liberty as 'deleted scenes'.

notes.title: About errors that can not load savedata before ver2.10
notes.content:
I'm sorry.

Because of the changed file name, savedata before ver2.10 became unusable.

We are preparing a patch now, but if you want to play right away We predict that it will be earlier to start a new game.

We apologize for any inconvenience.
Please wait for a while.

notes.title: Fixed shutdown error (updated to ver2.10)
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

We uploaded a client that deleted double-byte characters. (ver 2.10)

We think that the cause of the error has been deleted.

If stable startup is possible, in the next update, add Takeda and Liberty as 'deleted scenes'.

notes.title: About changed girls.
notes.content:
We are not good at English, I'm sorry.



We have not changed girls by censorship.

We felt those girls are badly drawn so we changed them.

When we add girls again we plan to add it in the form of "deleted scene".

But we have too many bug fixes now, so the schedule is undecided.

We will do our best, so please wait for a while.

notes.title: About the error code currently being checked
notes.content:
We are currently checking the symptoms that the following error code appears and ends even if you start the game.


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LoadGraphic ERROR: Cannot find the following files

ERROR: Cannot find [\steam\steamapps\common\SengokuNeet\Data\MapChip\[?]ed3.png]

File Read Error *Continuing play can result in shutdown errors
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Perhaps the cause of symptoms is that 2 byte characters are used in file names.

We will cut down sleeping hours to fix, but we guess It will take three days at the soonest.

I Apologize for customers who can not play with an error code.

I hope you can wait until the correction work is completed.


We will tell you in "RECENT UPDATES" when correction work is completed.
